target: Add a read-only UI status collector, artifact durability classifier, ui_status JSON Schema, and minimal dopetask ui status --json CLI surface for later report and cockpit consumers.
invariants: dope-agent-system remains asset/template/reference authority only; this packet performs no dope-agent-system writes.
PAL/clink remains planning/context only and is not execution transport.
This packet is status collector foundation only.
Do not implement dopetask report, dopetask cockpit, Asset Library UI, DAS file listing or preview, mutating launchers, or audit panes.
Do not add textual, dependencies, pyproject.toml changes, uv.lock changes, runner implementation changes, adapter behavior changes, or routing scoring changes.
Do not call dopetask doctor, dopetask route plan, tp series exec, tp exec, or any task execution command.
Do not write SERIES_STATE.json, EXEC.json, EXEC_ERROR.json, SERIES_CONTEXT.json, ROUTE_PLAN.json, proof bundles, or out/tp_series artifacts.
Default status collection must be read-only and idempotent.

The only runtime output this packet may write is optional status JSON to an explicit --out path and, only when explicitly requested, runner health refresh output from the accepted runner-health module.

verify: python3 -m dopetask ui status --json | python3 -m json.tool

python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator
schema = json.loads(Path('dopetask_schemas/ui_status.schema.json').read_text())
payload = json.loads(Path('/tmp/dopetask_ui_status_tp_dt_ui_status_0001.json').read_text())
Draft202012Validator.check_schema(schema)
errors = sorted(Draft202012Validator(schema).iter_errors(payload), key=lambda e: list(e.path))
if errors:
    for error in errors:
        print(error.message)
    raise SystemExit(1)
print('ui-status-artifact-schema-valid')
PY
grep -R "import textual\|from textual" src/dopetask tests || true
grep -R "dopetask doctor\|route plan\|tp series exec" src/dopetask/ui tests/ui || true

pr.title: Add read-only UI status collector
pr.body: Adds the shared UI status data layer, artifact durability classification, schema, and minimal JSON CLI surface.

steps.task: Inspect accepted dependency proofs, Opus design artifacts, runtime artifact schemas, runner-health module, workspace resolver, and existing UI CLI registration before editing.
requirements: Treat runtime artifact schemas as structure authority.
Treat SERIES_STATE.json packet.status as current packet state authority.
Treat EXEC_ERROR.json as historical error evidence, not current state by itself.

steps.task: Create the status collector, durability classifier, ui_status schema, and minimal dopetask ui status JSON CLI surface.
requirements: Collector validates artifacts before structured consumption.
A bad artifact must produce an error marker without blocking other artifacts.
Durability classification must use git ls-files and git check-ignore.
CLI --out must refuse proof/ and resolved dope-agent-system paths.
validation: python3 -m dopetask ui status --json | python3 -m json.tool

steps.task: Add focused status tests, create proof and implementer report artifacts, run validation commands, and commit only allowlisted files if clean.
requirements: Tests must prove default collection writes no files.
Tests must prove auth_mode defaults to unknown and EXEC_ERROR.json alone is not current failure state.
Tests must prove tracked, ignored, and missing durability classifications.
Proof must record validation exit codes and self-referential commit hash caveat.
commands: python3 -m dopetask ui status --json | python3 -m json.tool
